reviewMethod: Read-only installed implementation, contract and regression inspection plus independent complete source-pin audit. Rust execution below is parent-attributed; this review performs no Rust or PostgreSQL execution and no formal refinement proof.

reviewObservations.observation: The new API accepts no caller rule/action/output inventory. Each nonempty scoped row has exactly the actual owner scans and each Fact target matches its scan; actual requirements drive eager rule preflight and all evaluated truth maps.

The existing finite Record interpreter normalizes the supplied subject, association facts, context and scoped resources against the same immutable source/catalog. Complete coverage, generation agreement and trusted status remain caller assertions. Unsupported graph namespace paths refuse.

Complete declaration/cell checking precedes evaluation. Only evaluated truths enter the existing selection fold; Original cells additionally require the actual scan Fact field, declared coverage and exact normalized equality. Identity keys do not substitute for missing field values.

Every occurrence across subject, supplied population and scoped rows is compared by nominal identity and complete normalized field/absence assignments. Repeated coherent bag/self-join occurrences are allowed; conflicting assignments refuse before evaluation.

Parent-executed unmasked controls remove only the projected resourceId field or only its coverage, retaining valid identity keys and otherwise valid membership. Both require exact EVALUATION refusal; domain-valid substituted Original values also refuse.

Identical same-identity Resource population/scoped values pass, including salary integerToken 1e2 versus 100. Changed non-policy salary refuses in unmasked mode. An identical subject population copy passes; its individually valid missing field inventory refuses. Later scoped-row conflict and scope swaps also refuse.

Generated rule/action/scan identifier text is charged before each clone against a separate aggregate 1M-visit/16M-byte metadata ledger. Parent-executed 129-rule fixture uses 128-byte IDs: 512 rows pass; 1024 rows with valid cells and combined input below4M refuse EVALUATION/model before downstream selection. This addresses truth-map byte amplification; it is not an all-allocation or CPU bound.

Combined cut/scoped-row UTF-8 text is bounded4M. Each text has its own depth64/1M-node parser bound. Existing maxFacts/maxSteps, normalized and copied scalar payload ledgers remain; malformed typed literals may retain WFT-SECURITY-LITERAL. Scope/coherence/metadata refusal uses EVALUATION, with prior declaration/cell/selection boundaries preserved.

Even empty result batches preflight actual rule dependencies and refuse incomplete relevant association coverage. No unit success grants query permission. Query predicates, actual join provenance, complete result enumeration, authenticated/current authority and release remain unproved; public lowering stays blocked and no release artifact is issued.

resolvedFindings: Generated truth metadata is now charged before cloning, with isolated actual API coverage.
Missing Original field/coverage and cross-population/subject coherence controls added.
Self-join fixture now allows distinct resource rows; actual query provenance remains excluded.
Contract distinguishes combined bytes, per-text parser nodes and retained literal diagnostics.
scope: Conditional owner source-expression evaluation and direct-field selected-cell/value correspondence over unauthenticated caller-supplied finite Record facts. No native cut, actual query/join result correspondence, general runtime/compiler refinement, public lowering, guarded release or backend acceptance is established.
